threads.title: Fixed rate expiring next month, is 14 cents reasonable right now?
threads.body: My electricity plan ends on the 18th and the renewal letter feels high. 1,400 sq ft, about 1,100 kWh in a normal month.

threads.title: Ohmbrook charged me a cancellation fee after I moved
threads.body: I gave them my move-out date and still got an early termination charge on the final electricity bill. Has anyone had this reversed?

threads.title: Anyone compared Ohmbrook vs the default utility rate?
threads.body: The default electricity rate went up again. Trying to work out whether a 12 month fixed rate is actually better over a full year.

threads.title: New to Texas, how does picking an electricity plan even work?
threads.body: Moving into a place outside the city utility area. I have never had to choose a power company before and the plan documents are confusing.

threads.title: Demand charge is half of our bill, what can we do?
threads.body: Small bakery. Our commercial electricity bill is mostly the demand charge from the ovens starting at the same time.

threads.title: PSA: the free nights plans are not free
threads.body: Did the math on the Tallowmere free nights electricity plan. The daytime rate is so high I would pay more overall.

threads.title: Someone at my door said he was from the electric company
threads.body: He wanted to see my electric bill to check for a discount. I said no. Was this a supplier trying to switch providers on me?

threads.title: Is it worth switching gas supplier before winter?
threads.body: My gas bill doubled last January. Should I sign a fixed natural gas rate now or stay with the utility?

threads.title: Ohmbrook app has been down for two days
threads.body: Cannot pay my power bill or see usage. Support line has a long hold.

threads.title: Which providers have you actually been happy with?
threads.body: Looking to switch providers, ideally an electricity plan with no monthly fee.

threads.title: Budget billing vs paying actual usage?
threads.body: Our power bill swings from $80 to $310. Does levelized billing cost more in the long run?

threads.title: Got a letter saying my supplier is changing and I never agreed
threads.body: I did not switch providers. The electric bill now shows a company I have never heard of.

threads.title: Cheapest electricity plan for a 900 sq ft apartment?
threads.body: Use around 600 kWh. Most of the advertised rates only work at 1,000 or 2,000 kWh.

threads.title: Has anyone used an energy broker for a restaurant group?
threads.body: Three locations, all on different commercial electricity contracts. Wondering if a broker is worth the fee.

threads.title: Tallowmere or stay with the utility?
threads.body: They are offering a 24 month electricity rate. Anyone compared it to the utility price?

threads.title: Ohmbrook was actually easy to leave
threads.body: Posting because people only share bad stories. Switched my electric service in one call and there was no fee.

threads.title: Utilities checklist before closing?
threads.body: First house. When do I set up the electricity plan and gas bill so nothing gets shut off on day one?

threads.title: No, your provider does not control outages
threads.body: Seeing misinformation in the storm thread. The company you pay for your electricity plan does not own the wires.

threads.title: Energy broker quote feels too good
threads.body: Broker says 30% off our commercial electricity with no fee. What is the catch?

threads.title: Ohmbrook deposit refund taking forever
threads.body: Closed the account in good standing. The electricity deposit still has not come back after six weeks.

threads.title: Tallowmere renewal jumped 60%
threads.body: The intro electricity rate ended and I missed the notice. Frustrated but also my fault I guess.

threads.title: Community solar credits on your electric bill, legit?
threads.body: Trying to understand how the credit shows up next to the normal electricity charges.

threads.title: Renters: can you pick your own electricity plan?
threads.body: Depends on the neighborhood apparently. Anyone have a simple way to check?

threads.title: Ohmbrook fixed plan, month 9 review
threads.body: Steady electricity rate so far, the bill is predictable and that was the point for me.

threads.title: How do you forecast energy costs?
threads.body: Commercial electricity is our second biggest expense and I have no method beyond last year plus ten percent.

threads.title: Gas supplier switch saved us about $140 last winter
threads.body: Sharing numbers. Fixed natural gas rate from October to April compared with the utility default.

threads.title: Is autopay discount worth it?
threads.body: Every electricity plan quote assumes autopay and paperless. Feels like the real rate is hidden.

threads.title: Tallowmere customer service experience?
threads.body: Considering their electricity plan because it is the lowest on the list. How are they when something goes wrong?

threads.title: Electric and gas from the same supplier?
threads.body: Does bundling the electricity and natural gas service ever lower the power bill?

threads.title: Best time of year to lock a fixed rate?
threads.body: I keep reading spring for electricity. Any truth to it?
